conditions.title: Autonomous chain registration exists
conditions.description: PB can create a new Goal->Gap->Dependency chain from a real detected block, without a human hand-authoring it in a dedicated phase (addresses remaining_gap_1).

conditions.title: At least 2 independent real domains flow through the Development Intelligence loop
conditions.description: Currently only the movie-factory/GPU domain (3 chains) does. SSI (or another real domain) must have at least one real Goal/Gap/chain flowing through the same Priority/Execution/Evidence Contract machinery before an Experience Layer's lessons could generalize beyond one domain (addresses remaining_gap_2).

conditions.title: Chain-less goals' status is explicitly classified
conditions.description: goal_repository_foundation and goal_project_brain_operational's lack of a chain must be explicitly marked as either "permanent by design" or "pending instrumentation" so an Experience Layer does not silently misinterpret their absence of data (addresses remaining_gap_3).

conditions.title: 4-layer + provenance + execution consistency holds at time of transition
conditions.description: Standard closing condition already used every phase since PHASE-943 -- must still pass with 0 violations at the moment Experience Layer work begins.

next_step: PHASE-964 onward (up to PHASE-970 per this arc's stated horizon) should address EC-01, EC-02, EC-03 in roughly that priority order -- EC-01 unblocks everything downstream (without it, EC-02's SSI connection would still require manual chain-authoring); EC-02 and EC-03 can likely proceed in parallel once EC-01 exists. No Experience Layer design or implementation should begin before all 4 conditions are met.
